headline.statement: Late-period GEV did not identify a credible intensification of the early 100-year depth (raw fitted recurrence 2.27e+09 yr discarded as unstable).

landslide_trigger.presentation: rainfall classifier, AUC out-of-sample — not a Caine-style I–D threshold
landslide_trigger.note: Fitted exponent b can be positive (inverse of classic Caine I = a·D^b with b<0). Do not present the power law as a physical intensity–duration threshold; the claim that survives scrutiny is the held-out rainfall-classifier AUC.

pot_gpd.method: POT/GPD, 95th percentile, 3-day decluster of regional daily max
pot_gpd.note: Regional daily max is a different sample than GEV median-of-station-maxima; use as a tail cross-check, not a replacement headline.

imerg.reason: GPM IMERG V07 is on NASA Earthdata (login). Not fused; headline is ISD GEV only.

datasets: ERA5-Land from nearest cached ISD coordinate RAXAUL (26.983, 84.85); city centroid fetch was rate-limited
provenance.data_status: model output — GEV on ERA5-Land from nearest cached ISD coordinate RAXAUL (26.983, 84.85); city centroid fetch was rate-limited; not gauge fusion
provenance.method: annual station maxima pooled by year using median; stationary GEV by era; non-parametric bootstrap; POT/GPD on regional daily max
